verdict.rationale: Capacities documents its own synchronization across all devices and offline-first sync that catches up when you reconnect, which covers the sync half of the story. Nothing in the pack mentions end-to-end encryption or the vendor being unable to read notes, so the privacy half is unevidenced. Missing for 10: any documentation of end-to-end or zero-knowledge encryption, independent corroboration of sync reliability across devices, and detail on how sync works.

support.subject: As a power-user, an official sync service keeps my notes updated across all my devices with end-to-end encryption the vendor can't read

citations.quote: Capacities is an offline-first application. You can work offline and your changes will get synchronized as soon as you're back online.
